amendment_rule.rule: Never overwrite a reviewed run. Corrections must name the superseded run and preserve both manifests.

claim_ceiling: This panel can validate the behavior of the text-only measurement pipeline against a hard-routed synthetic phantom. It cannot validate a mechanism in a natural language model.

outcome_exposure.at_freeze: synthetic smoke outcomes observed during repository bootstrap
outcome_exposure.interpretation: This is a regression contract, not a preregistration.

phase_contract.evaluate: May read the sealed route key only after predictions are written.
phase_contract.plan: Build projection panels and feature vectors without evaluation labels.
phase_contract.preflight: Run the current structural contract lint and protocol-manifest hash check with zero model calls.
phase_contract.sealing_limit: The current runner simulates prediction locking in one process; it is not a capability-separated blind evaluation.

primary_readouts: advantage over a single baseline-projection decision
prospective accuracy on heldout challenge projections

scope.phantom: shared renderer with a hidden hard gate selecting semantic evidence or a surface cue
scope.unit: target x heldout case projection orbit

stop_conditions: advantage over the single baseline-projection decision below 0.25
reduced matched-output orbit does not force abstention
